name: Toggle Topic Questions Expand
description: Toggle whether the current topic card shows all questions or only the first 3. After expanding, wait for new rows then render KaTeX.

TOGGLE_EXPAND.name: Toggle expanded topic questions
TOGGLE_EXPAND.__wwdescription: Expand this topic's full question list, or collapse back to 3 if already expanded.

IF_EXPANDED.name: Did we expand?
IF_EXPANDED.__wwdescription: Only re-render KaTeX when showing more questions, not when collapsing.

WAIT_EXPAND.name: Wait for expanded questions
WAIT_EXPAND.__wwdescription: Give the repeater time to render newly visible question rows.

RENDER_MATH.name: Render KaTeX after expand
RENDER_MATH.__wwdescription: Safely typeset LaTeX in known question-prompt elements via head-script helpers.
